g.text: Solid = base or stow. Dashed = pose / reserve.
All views use the same 3D block/link coordinates.
Cover coral L1-L3 from station or floor, clear
either reef algae tier for partners, and deliver
algae to processor. Retain a deep-cage option.
Alliance coverage, not a predicted throughput or
short lift -> L1/L2/L3 offer -> release and
retreat. Station: receive directly in the same
wrist. One coral throughout; separately test loose
and initially algae-stacked floor cases rather than
Stow coral path; use the same algae head at floor
or provisional low/high reef pose. Retain, retract
over the intact bumper, drive to processor and
offer from the shared low-head pose. Different
score gives 6 to us; a later opponent HP net score
Check upper-grip floor algae and processor release
at the shared low-head pose against measured
geometry; verify both reef heights separately. Then
bench-test belt-to-lift retention and the deep
hook/load path. No physical tests have run. No L4
or net. At equal success, L4 beats L3 TELEOP rate
only below a 25% cycle-time premium (5/4); equality
ties. Times are unmeasured. A lower center of mass
STAGE 2 / PROPOSED GEOMETRY. No contact, stability, loaded climb, ballistics or rules-compliance pass.
Hardware endpoints fit the stated reference envelope; trajectories, piece clearance and real field interfaces remain unverified. Zero Onshape / CAD-kernel calls.
